evidence.build_method: non-powered soft or semi-rigid cuff mockup only

field_contract.evidence_date: Use an ISO 8601 calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format for evidence.date. Future-dated mockup evidence is invalid because it cannot be completed evidence.
field_contract.placeholder_values: Placeholder text such as PENDING is treated as missing evidence case-insensitively and after trimming. Lowercase, padded, or whitespace-only placeholders cannot satisfy required FR-017 mockup fields.
field_contract.evidence_chronology: Mockup evidence.date must be the same as or later than the linked measurement evidence.date. Do not fabricate or backdate mockup evidence before measurement evidence exists.
field_contract.build_method: Mockup evidence.build_method must explicitly state a non-powered soft or semi-rigid cuff mockup. Build-method text that omits non-powered or omits soft/semi-rigid construction is invalid because FR-017 cuffs are not powered joints, frames, armor, or load-bearing structures.
field_contract.record_linkage: evidence.measurement_record_path must resolve to the same measurement record path passed into the mockup readiness gate. Do not point a mockup record at stale, copied, or unrelated measurements.
field_contract.materials: Use specific material/component descriptions, not generic approval text.
field_contract.constraints: Use unquoted JSON boolean true only when the mockup condition is directly verified. Use false for a verified failure; false blocks progression. Do not use yes/no/1/0 or quoted true/false strings.
field_contract.side_checks: Use true only when the left/right mockup check is directly verified against the completed measurement record.
